02Fonts

The website loads these families from Google Fonts. All are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, which allows free use, modification and embedding, including in commercial projects:

  • Plus Jakarta Sans — Tokotype
  • Space Grotesk — Florian Karsten
  • JetBrains Mono — JetBrains
  • Silkscreen — Jason Kottke
  • Syne — Bonjour Monde / Lucas Descroix
  • Outfit — Smartsheet / Rodrigo Fuenzalida

The desktop overlay GUI bundles ProductSans-Medium.ttf. Product Sans is a proprietary Google brand typeface and is not covered by the SIL Open Font License. It is not redistributed as part of the public website; if you reuse the client bundle, replace it with an open font such as Inter or Plus Jakarta Sans.

04Images, icons and audio

  • Logo, app icons, OG card (logo.png, icon-48/96/192/512.png, icon-maskable-512.png, apple-touch-icon.png, og-cover.png) — original PulseClient artwork, © PulseClient.
  • Illustrations (error404missing.png/.webp, mogged.png, vpn-block-preview.png) — created for PulseClient, © PulseClient.
  • Bot skins (images/bots/*.png) — original pixel art made for the PulseClient community bots, © PulseClient.
  • Minecraft skins and player avatars — each belongs to its creator or the player who uploaded it; rendered for display only.
  • Sound effect (evila.mp3) — a short alert clip used inside the staff dashboard. Its provenance is not recorded in the repository; it is not part of the public marketing pages.

Before shipping the repository as a product or template, confirm you own or license every media file you did not create — the internal LICENSES.md file tracks the ones that still need a written source.
